blocks.text: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower.
Locally nicknamed 'La dame de fer' (French for 'Iron Lady'), it was constructed as the centerpiece of the 1889 World's Fair and has since become a global cultural icon of France.
